metadata.generationSummary:
## project-31ca17ee - Production React Native App

**App Type**: fitness
**Tech Stack**: Expo SDK ~54.0.30, React Native 0.81.5

### Implemented Screens
- `app/index.tsx` - Stunning onboarding/splash screen with full-bleed fitness imagery
- `app/(auth)/_layout.tsx` - Auth stack layout
- `app/(auth)/login.tsx` - Beautiful login with gradient header
- `app/(auth)/signup.tsx` - Registration with fitness goal selection
- `app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx` - Main tab navigation with coral theme
- `app/(tabs)/index.tsx` - Home dashboard with today's stats, activity rings, quick actions
- `app/(tabs)/activities.tsx` - Activity history with filtering and beautiful cards
- `app/(tabs)/profile.tsx` - User profile with achievements and settings
- `app/workout/start.tsx` - Active workout tracking with real-time stats
- `app/workout/[id].tsx` - Workout detail and summary view

### Key Files & Responsibilities
- `types/index.ts` - All TypeScript interfaces (User, Activity, Goal, Achievement, DailyStats)
- `constants/Colors.ts` - Full coral reef theme color system with dark mode
- `store/useAuthStore.ts` - Authentication state, login/signup/logout actions
- `store/useStore.ts` - Main app state: activities, goals, achievements, stats
- `components/ui/Button.tsx` - Multi-variant button with haptic feedback
- `components/ui/Card.tsx` - Elevated cards with coral accents
- `components/ui/Input.tsx` - Styled inputs with labels and error states
- `components/ui/Avatar.tsx` - User avatar with fallback initials
- `components/ui/Badge.tsx` - Status badges (active, completed, paused)
- `components/ui/Skeleton.tsx` - Shimmer loading placeholders
- `components/ui/ThemedView.tsx` - Theme-aware view container
- `components/ui/ThemedText.tsx` - Theme-aware text component
- `components/shared/ActivityCard.tsx` - Activity list item with stats
- `components/shared/StatCard.tsx` - Dashboard stat display
- `components/shared/ActivityRing.tsx` - Circular progress indicator
- `components/shared/AchievementBadge.tsx` - Achievement display
- `hooks/useColorScheme.ts` - Color scheme detection

### Design Tokens Applied
- Theme: Coral Reef (playful-vibrant)
- Colors: Primary pink-500, Secondary orange-100, Accent yellow-400, Background white
- Gradient: `['#ec4899', '#f43f5e', '#fb7185']`
- Typography: System fonts with bold headlines (text-3xl, text-2xl), body text-base
- Spacing/Radius: rounded-3xl for cards, rounded-lg for buttons, gap-4 spacing rhythm

### Important Patterns & Conventions
- State management: Zustand with async actions ready for Supabase
- Navigation: Expo Router with (auth) and (tabs) groups, stack for workout screens
- Styling: NativeWind (Tailwind CSS) throughout
- Data fetching/mocking: Realistic mock data in stores with UUID IDs
- Animations: Built-in Animated API (fade, scale, spring)
- Auth Guard: Root layout checks auth state and redirects appropriately

### Implemented Features
- Email/password authentication with beautiful onboarding
- Fitness goal selection during signup (lose weight, build muscle, stay active, improve endurance)
- Real-time workout tracking with timer, calories, distance
- Activity type selection (running, cycling, strength, yoga, swimming, hiking)
- Dashboard with daily stats rings (calories, duration, activities)
- Weekly activity chart visualization
- Activity history with type filtering
- Detailed workout summaries
- Achievement badges system (First Workout, Week Warrior, Calorie Crusher, etc.)
- Personal records tracking
- User profile with editable settings
- Pull-to-refresh on activity lists
- Beautiful coral reef gradient accents throughout
- Dark mode support
- Haptic feedback on interactions

### How to Run
```bash
cd project-31ca17ee
npm install
npx expo start
```
